effect_description_eng:
[When Digivolving] ＜Blitz＞ (If your opponent has 1 or more memory, this Digimon may attack.) When DNA digivolving, for every 4 cards in this Digimon's digivolution cards, delete 1 of your opponent's Digimon with a play cost of 20 or less and trash the top card of your opponent's security stack.
[All Turns] [Once Per Turn] When a card is removed from a player's security stack, unsuspend this Digimon.
